def ledger(ops: list[str]) -> tuple[dict[str, int], list[int]]:
    balances: dict[str, int] = {}
    frozen: set[str] = set()
    history: list[tuple] = []
    rejected: list[int] = []

    for i, operation in enumerate(ops):
        tokens = operation.split()
        if not tokens:
            rejected.append(i)
            continue

        verb = tokens[0]

        if verb == "undo":
            if len(tokens) != 1 or not history:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue

            change = history.pop()
            kind = change[0]

            if kind == "open":
                _, account = change
                del balances[account]
                frozen.discard(account)
            elif kind == "deposit":
                _, account, amount = change
                balances[account] -= amount
            elif kind == "withdraw":
                _, account, amount = change
                balances[account] += amount
            elif kind == "transfer":
                _, source, destination, amount = change
                balances[source] += amount
                balances[destination] -= amount
            elif kind == "freeze":
                _, account = change
                frozen.discard(account)
            elif kind == "unfreeze":
                _, account = change
                frozen.add(account)
            continue

        if verb == "open":
            if len(tokens) != 3:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            account, raw_amount = tokens[1], tokens[2]
            if not raw_amount.isascii() or not raw_amount.isdigit() or account in balances:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            amount = int(raw_amount)
            balances[account] = amount
            history.append(("open", account))

        elif verb == "deposit":
            if len(tokens) != 3:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            account, raw_amount = tokens[1], tokens[2]
            if not raw_amount.isascii() or not raw_amount.isdigit() or account not in balances:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            amount = int(raw_amount)
            if amount <= 0:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            balances[account] += amount
            history.append(("deposit", account, amount))

        elif verb == "withdraw":
            if len(tokens) != 3:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            account, raw_amount = tokens[1], tokens[2]
            if not raw_amount.isascii() or not raw_amount.isdigit() or account not in balances:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            amount = int(raw_amount)
            if amount <= 0 or account in frozen or balances[account] < amount:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            balances[account] -= amount
            history.append(("withdraw", account, amount))

        elif verb == "transfer":
            if len(tokens) != 4:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            source, destination, raw_amount = tokens[1], tokens[2], tokens[3]
            if (not raw_amount.isascii() or not raw_amount.isdigit()
                    or source == destination
                    or source not in balances or destination not in balances):
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            amount = int(raw_amount)
            if amount <= 0 or source in frozen or balances[source] < amount:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            balances[source] -= amount
            balances[destination] += amount
            history.append(("transfer", source, destination, amount))

        elif verb == "freeze":
            if len(tokens) != 2:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            account = tokens[1]
            if account not in balances or account in frozen:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            frozen.add(account)
            history.append(("freeze", account))

        elif verb == "unfreeze":
            if len(tokens) != 2:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            account = tokens[1]
            if account not in balances or account not in frozen:
                rejected.append(i)
                continue
            frozen.remove(account)
            history.append(("unfreeze", account))

        else:
            rejected.append(i)

    return balances, rejected
